# Know the Odds

> Know the Odds (creynia's casino lab, https://creynia.com/) is a free set of learning resources and simulators by creynia for the math of casino games. Three step-by-step courses (craps, baccarat, Ultimate Texas Hold'em) go from the basics to perfect strategy with short lessons and quizzes, each paired with a real-rules table simulator that shows the expected value and house edge of every bet or decision. The roulette simulator runs betting systems such as the Martingale over thousands of simulated sessions to show their real risk. Education only: every casino game has a house edge and no betting system beats it. Each app has its own llms.txt and llms-full.txt with the full lesson text.

All apps run in the browser, install on a phone, work offline, need no account and show no ads. Source code: https://github.com/creynia. Problem-gambling help (US): call or text 1-800-GAMBLER.

## crappy: Craps

- [crappy](https://creynia.com/crappy/): Learn craps free, from "what's a point?" to the bets worth making and the ones to skip, on a real-rules table that shows the house edge of every wager.
- [Craps course](https://creynia.com/crappy/learn/): All craps lessons by chapter, with summaries.
- [Craps odds chart](https://creynia.com/crappy/bets/): Every craps bet with payout, true odds, chance to win and house edge, lowest edge first; one page per bet.
- [Best and worst craps bets](https://creynia.com/crappy/best-and-worst-bets/): The lowest-edge bets and the sucker bets, ranked by house edge per bet and per roll.
- [Craps odds bet and house edge](https://creynia.com/crappy/odds-bet-house-edge/): Combined house edge of Pass and Don't Pass with 1x to 100x odds, including 3-4-5x.
- [Craps dice probability](https://creynia.com/crappy/dice-probability/): The 36 dice combinations, the odds of every total, of a 7, of making each point and of the hardways.
- [Craps glossary](https://creynia.com/crappy/glossary/): Definitions of craps terms.
- [crappy llms.txt](https://creynia.com/crappy/llms.txt): Index of crappy's pages for LLMs.
- [crappy llms-full.txt](https://creynia.com/crappy/llms-full.txt): Full text of every craps lesson and reference page.

## baccaratton: Baccarat (Punto Banco)

- [baccaratton](https://creynia.com/baccaratton/): Learn baccarat free: the third-card rule, why Banker pays a commission, and which side bets are traps, on a table that shows the EV of every bet.
- [Baccarat course](https://creynia.com/baccaratton/learn/): All baccarat lessons by chapter, with summaries.
- [Baccarat odds: Banker vs Player](https://creynia.com/baccaratton/odds/): Win rates and house edges of Banker, Player and Tie, the commission explained, and odds by number of decks.
- [Baccarat third-card rule](https://creynia.com/baccaratton/third-card-rule/): The Player and Banker drawing rules as charts, and how often each case happens.
- [Baccarat bets and house edges](https://creynia.com/baccaratton/bets/): Banker, Player, Tie and the side bets with payouts, exact house edges and win rates; one page per bet.
- [Does Martingale work in baccarat?](https://creynia.com/baccaratton/systems/): The rules and exact hourly cost of betting systems such as Martingale, Fibonacci and Paroli, and why none changes the house edge.
- [Baccarat glossary](https://creynia.com/baccaratton/glossary/): Definitions of baccarat terms.
- [baccaratton llms.txt](https://creynia.com/baccaratton/llms.txt): Index of baccaratton's pages for LLMs.
- [baccaratton llms-full.txt](https://creynia.com/baccaratton/llms-full.txt): Full text of every baccarat lesson and reference page.

## holdumb: Ultimate Texas Hold'em

- [holdumb](https://creynia.com/holdumb/): Learn Ultimate Texas Hold'em free: when to raise 4x, 2x, 1x or check, and how the Blind and Trips pay, with the EV of every decision on every street.
- [Ultimate Texas Hold'em course](https://creynia.com/holdumb/learn/): All Ultimate Texas Hold'em lessons by chapter, with summaries.
- [Ultimate Texas Hold'em strategy chart](https://creynia.com/holdumb/strategy/): When to raise 4x preflop, 2x on the flop, and 1x or fold on the river; Perfect, Basic and Simple strategies.
- [Ultimate Texas Hold'em house edge and odds](https://creynia.com/holdumb/house-edge/): The exact house edge and element of risk, the cost of simpler strategies, Trips paytable edges and final-hand odds.
- [Ultimate Texas Hold'em bets and paytables](https://creynia.com/holdumb/bets/): Ante, Blind, Play and Trips, with the Blind paytable and five Trips paytables and their house edges.
- [Ultimate Texas Hold'em glossary](https://creynia.com/holdumb/glossary/): Definitions of Ultimate Texas Hold'em terms.
- [holdumb llms.txt](https://creynia.com/holdumb/llms.txt): Index of holdumb's pages for LLMs.
- [holdumb llms-full.txt](https://creynia.com/holdumb/llms-full.txt): Full text of every Ultimate Texas Hold'em lesson and reference page.

## spinner: Roulette strategy lab

- [spinner](https://creynia.com/spinner/): Build a roulette betting system (Martingale, Fibonacci, James Bond or your own rules), run it over thousands of seeded simulated sessions, and see the average result, bust risk and drawdowns.
- [Roulette strategies](https://creynia.com/spinner/strategies/): Simulated results for common roulette betting systems (flat, Martingale, Fibonacci, d'Alembert, Labouchere, James Bond), 10,000 sessions of up to 500 spins each on a European wheel.
- [Roulette betting-system research](https://creynia.com/spinner/research/): Can a roulette betting system beat the house? Ten chapters of simulation research with the data behind every chart.
- [Does the Martingale work in roulette?](https://creynia.com/spinner/research/martingale/): Why doubling feels like it works, and what 10,000 simulated sessions show.
- [Roulette house edge: European vs American](https://creynia.com/spinner/research/edge/): The exact house edge of every bet on European, American and triple-zero wheels.
- [Sources](https://creynia.com/spinner/sources/): The references behind spinner's math and research.
- [spinner llms.txt](https://creynia.com/spinner/llms.txt): Index of spinner's pages for LLMs.
- [spinner llms-full.txt](https://creynia.com/spinner/llms-full.txt): Full text of every spinner strategy page.
